standard-dialogue-talking-to-the-snake-c.player: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?

standard-dialogue-talking-to-the-snake-c.text: The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.

standard-dialogue-using-a-coin-on-the-mo.text: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.

options.text: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?

steps.player: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough space in the inventory:

steps.npc: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.

steps.text: If the player already owns a flute:

steps.npc: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.

steps.text: If the player already owns a basket:

steps.npc: Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.

steps.text: If the player does not own either:

steps.npc: If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!

steps.text: The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
a snake flute and snake basket
If the player already owns both the flute and basket:

steps.npc: I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.

options.text: I want to talk to you about animal charming.

steps.player: I want to talk to you about animal charming.

steps.text: If the player no longer owns a music scroll:

steps.player: I've lost some of the gear you gave me.

steps.npc: There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.

steps.text: If the player already owns a music scroll:

steps.player: Can you teach me any more about animal charming.

steps.npc: No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
